item.title: Cardano Gains Institutional Credibility With 21 UNDP Use Cases
item.summary: Cardano is strengthening its institutional positioning after being associated with 21 of 42 blockchain use cases highlighted by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), placing the network across areas including financial services, digital identity, public-sector infrastructure, sustainability and development programs. The breadth of these use cases indicates that Cardano’s research-driven blockchain architecture is being considered […] The post Cardano Gains Institutional Credibility With 21 UNDP Use Cases appeared first on CoinTrust .
